notes.title: 🍕 Pizza Syndicate Returns – The Classic ’90s Tycoon is Back!
notes.content:
🍕 The Classic Returns: Pizza Syndicate is Back! 🍕
Hey everyone! We’re thrilled to announce the return of a true cult classic—Pizza Syndicate! Originally released in the late ’90s, this quirky business sim won hearts with its mix of strategy, humor, and a dash of chaos. Now, for the first time in years, it’s back—fully compatible with modern systems!  

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4004630/Pizza_Syndicate/"][/dynamiclink]🕹️ Originally released in the late ’90s, Pizza Syndicate was a cult-favorite business sim that mixed strategy with humor and a dash of chaos. Now it’s back—fully playable on modern systems for the first time! 

In Pizza Syndicate, you’ll: 
✨ Build your pizza empire from a humble pizzeria to a city-wide franchise. 
👨‍🍳 Hire, train, and manage your staff while keeping customers happy. 
📈 Balance menus, marketing, and finances like a true tycoon. 
🕵️‍♂️ Dip into the underground syndicate to sabotage rivals, influence markets, and… maybe even hire a hitman or two. 😉 
😂 Enjoy tongue-in-cheek events, wacky scenarios, and that unmistakable retro charm.

This is business strategy with a deliciously mischievous twist.

💡 Whether you’re a fan of classic tycoon sims, economic strategy, or just love a good slice of pizza with chaos on top—this is the game for you.


👉 Wishlist Pizza Syndicate now and get ready to dominate the city—both above board and in the shadows


Join Our Pizza Syndicate Discord! 🍕

Want to chat with fellow tycoons, share your best pizza empire strategies, or just hang out with fans of classic sims? Join our official Discord!

notes.title: New content and features added - V 1.0.8
notes.content:
Hello Players,

Over the past two weeks, we have analyzed data gathered from users, read your constructive input, and reviewed suggestions on how to improve the game. The latest version, 1.0.8, incorporates some of the requests made by players during this time.

Content and features:
In this update, players now have the option to speed up movement. As you know, there are two docks in the game: an east-side dock and a west-side dock. From 6 am to 8 pm, you will now find a boat there, along with an individual offering transportation services for a fee of 5 pence (d).

Dock 1:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730556/b9fa73e5a05109ba25c40c1af69c3f187acbf9a8.png
Dock 2:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730556/2fcb05dfaa6d9f110ee3e9d2c40abe804d32b2e1.png

To use the service, simply walk down to the dock, engage in conversation with the boatman, pay the fee, and moments later, you will be transported to the other side of the city. This transportation works both ways, from west to east and east to west.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730556/8276b632106ab59210a26eab53388995e89b5659.png

Another content update in this version includes newspapers and family death events. For spoiler reasons, we won’t cover the specifics of family deaths here, but we can discuss the newspapers. There are now various stories and events described in newspapers nailed to the walls. These stories are based on real events from the plague outbreak and feature personal recollections recorded during that time.

Newspaper on wall:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730556/c23847ac3eb2657e4f74e57f13995186fea5af13.png

Newspaper opened:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730556/35fff3e038bcbba3285f1aa4fe4de66ceb51989b.png

Fixes and updates:
In addition to the new content, we’ve made some minor bug fixes and overall game improvements:

 Fixed a closing bug on controllers for the GoG version of the game.
 Fixed a sound bug that continued playing if you didn’t have enough money to buy from the fish market (only on the Epic version).
 Updated intro animation and adjusted movement speed in the intro.
 Updated family requirements after day 11.


We hope these improvements further enhance gameplay and provide a more satisfying experience for every player.

Please join our Discord channel to be part of our growing community and to stay in the loop about any news regarding the game: 
 Discord 

As always, these updates apply to all versions of the game on Steam, Epic, and GOG.
 Epic 
 GOG 

Thank you for being such a valued part of our community. 
We hope you enjoy your continued adventures in the streets of London!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 Update: UI Improvements and Bug Fixes!

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 - Updates and Fixes
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you all for playing our game, and a special thanks to those who report any issues, bugs, or strange behavior. Even if something isn't a bug, we are more than happy to look into anything that's reported, so please don’t hesitate to reach out if you suspect something is off.

The current active game version is now 1.0.4, and the fixes and updates it includes are as follows:

 Multi-collider interaction between carts, normal corpses, and wrapped corpses no longer causes a procedural bug.
 Some users were able to exploit the task generation system, which is now fixed.
 World adjustment system is no longer accessible.
 Markets and sellers no longer allow players to leave until the conversation is completed.
 Credits section updated.
 Save slot font size updated to display AM/PM.
 Notification added for blocked areas.
 Audio listeners disabled in the persistent game scene.

We hope these fixes improve your overall experience. ❤️

Note: These changes apply to all versions of the game on Steam, Epic, and GOG.

Important: These fixes unfortunately do not affect save files from the previous version, so they are likely to be corrupted if the bug you experienced was procedural. Otherwise, your save files should be fine.

Thank you again for your amazing support, and stay safe in the streets of London.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/

notes.title: Survive the Outbreak – Plague: London 1665 is Now Available!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

The wait is over! Step into the grim and perilous world of Plague: London 1665, now officially released on Steam, Epic and GoG!

Set during the devastating Bubonic Plague outbreak in 1665, this pixel art RPG plunges you into the heart of overcrowded and disease-ridden London. As a body collector, graveyard keeper, and family provider, your survival depends on your ability to navigate these treacherous streets.

🎮 Get Plague: London 1665 now and face the outbreak head-on!

Will you risk it all to keep the city clean and your family fed, or will you become another victim of the deadly plague?

Collect bodies from the river and streets:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/f6d0e2ecf77e545fdbda4175c452cf07c20cdd02.gif

Transport them:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/e6620042ebf8ae90bba60248681e03bf4d3d9f9d.gif

Bury them:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691164/d6c6eed1e2f8e5274b740a2d22a5f7a4c94f5a4b.gif

In Plague: London 1665, every choice matters:


 Collect and Bury: Brave the streets as you collect the bodies of the deceased and give them a proper burial while avoiding infection.
 Scavenge and Trade: Resources are scarce. Find ways to gather supplies and barter with other survivors in this unforgiving environment.
 Meet NPCs: Engage with a diverse cast of characters, each with their own stories and agendas, as you make critical decisions that will shape the outcome of the game.
 Survive: Balance the needs of the city, your family, and yourself in a world where every move could mean life or death.


With its blend of historical accuracy and intense gameplay, Plague: London 1665 offers a unique and immersive experience of one of history’s darkest times. The city’s fate is in your hands – will you survive?

Don't forget to share your experiences with us and leave a review! Your feedback is invaluable as we continue to improve and expand the game. Stay tuned for upcoming updates and announcements.

May luck be on your side in the streets of London.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/

notes.title: Everything You Need to Know: Story, Demo, Release 🎉📅
notes.content:
Dear Plague: London 1665 Enthusiasts,

We're excited to provide a development update on Plague: London 1665 and share our plans for the year, including the game's upcoming release. 
Your support means the world to us, and we can't wait to share this historical journey with you.

Plague: London 1665 has been in development since 2022, with all aspects, including art, development, music, and marketing, handled in-house. We've reached a point where we feel confident enough to focus on stabilizing the in-game economy and start preparing the game for release.

📚 Story:
As we approach the release, we're admittedly a bit nervous about how the game will be received. The narrative closely follows the events of a family during the outbreak of the bubonic plague in London. We were initially divided on how to present the story, but ultimately decided that telling the family's events exactly as they occurred was crucial. 
Plague: London 1665 is a game based on researched and documented events, offering players an authentic glimpse into the summer of 1665.

We hope players will appreciate the game for what it is.

Please join our Discord channel to be part of our growing community and to stay in the loop about any news regarding the game: https://discord.com/invite/mEqJJySDyw

🎮 Demo:
To encourage players to experience our game and provide valuable feedback, we're planning to release a short demo version of Plague: London 1665 in April or May 2024. Therefore, we invite you to stay tuned and witness our game.

🎉 Steam Next Fest:
Additionally, we've entered Steam Next Fest, scheduled for June this year. Keep an eye on our Steam Page for more announcements, and join our game streaming sessions during the event days.

📅 Release Date:
While we're still uncertain about the exact release date, the game's development cycle is nearing it's completion, and we're confident it will be released sometime this year. Unfortunately, we cannot commit to an exact date at this moment.

Stay tuned for more updates and thank you for your support on this historical journey through Plague: London 1665!
